subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept Control UI-specific bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` shortcuts now, or require explicit syntax aligned with `/name` and the title/label contract first?
rationale: The code uses the existing label path correctly, but the permanent command grammar and naming-field contract are user-facing product/API decisions that overlap active related work.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this external PR now and let a maintainer reopen or sponsor it after choosing the command grammar and label/title direction.

options.title: Sponsor current shortcuts
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts bare Control UI `/new <name>` plus `/label <name>` and owns the compatibility/session-state risk before merge.

options.title: Require explicit naming syntax
options.body: Ask for a replacement that keeps bare `/new` expectations intact and uses `/name`, `/label`, or `/new --name` only after the field contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this external PR now and let a maintainer reopen or sponsor it after choosing the command grammar and label/title direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the accepted `/name` command direction and are the strongest routing signal for command/session UX acceptance.
